updates.title: Versus
body: New modes: Versus (2P) and Versus Timed - two players on one keyboard (P1 W/S, Space, E; P2 I/K, L, O). Never ranked.
Menu: quick Local 2-player button and an Online (LOK) slot marked coming soon; footer credits GSIX Designs.

updates.title: Main menu
body: A simple main menu with a watching eyeball: pick mode, difficulty and other arenas, then PLAY (or Enter); the eye zooms away into your match. Skipped when the URL already sets mode, diff or arenas, or with ?menu=0.

updates.title: The pinball arm
body: The pinball paddle is now an arm: a second bar that extends horizontally from the middle of your paddle and swats up or down, always knocking the ball upward hard. The paddle still blocks on its own.
The arm unlocks when your glass breaks and your paddle is free. It stays on, and every third arm hit is a power hit that never switches off while you keep swatting.
Hold the swat and let go: the arm snaps back and fires the ball forward ("power hit unloaded").
Default score to win is now 24. 14 points grow your arena wall to wall, where it presses against the shaft, slows and stops.
A ball outside your arena belongs to the shaft: wind and the fall carry it. Breaking another arena's glass now also drops 3 tears.
Glass shards tumble freely, are shoved by balls and bounce off the walls but stay in view.
The arena ceiling and floor are steel girders clamped to the glass: lights, hairline cracks and a bent sparking clamp when a pane breaks.
The game opens with one background eye beside each wall eye, scattering into the old pattern as the game goes on.
When a game ends the screen settles while the arenas fall away, with a soft camera bounce.

updates.title: Game jam DJ
body: Default music: 72 fifty-second clips sampled evenly across the 3-hour Trijam mixtape (credit: Trijam, youtube.com/@TrijamGJ), DJ-cut between clip starts at random intervals with a crossfade. New Music volume in settings.

updates.title: Pinball paddle and wall eyes
body: The tear upgrade is now a pinball flipper paddle: flip it up or down (arrow keys, mouse left or right click, FLIP buttons, or tap the top or bottom half on touch). The swinging bar drives the ball with real physics, and every third hit is a power hit.
The NPC flips toward your ball when it holds the pinball paddle.
Wall eyes are now set into riveted wall plates with recessed bolted sockets and plate-metal lids, so they look part of the wall.

updates.title: Rocking arenas and the carousel
body: Your arena rocks with real physics: off-centre hits give torque, it swings on springs, and a tilted arena rolls the ball downhill.
New setting: Other arenas (Solo, 1, 3 or 5). They hang on a loose rotating carousel around you, bump into each other and into you, and play their own matches.
Triple score: break another arena's glass with your own ball for 3 points.
On Sharp and Relentless, balls knocked loose from other arenas can hit your glass.
New modifier: Rough Seas.

updates.title: Rules page and settings
body: A Rules and how it works page (the ? button, the gear menu, or /rules.html): controls, glass, scoring, tears, Power Paddle, comeback rules, difficulty, modes and tips.

Basic settings: difficulty, mode, score to win, time limit, master/effects/ambience volume, mute, fog quality, reduce motion, control hints, wind gauge, on-screen buttons and left-handed layout, reset to defaults. The panel pauses the game while open.

updates.title: The deep shaft
body: The arena now falls down a layered deep shaft: parallax structure, depth markers, debris, light shafts, wind gusts and buffeting.
Fog is now a shader pushed by the wind, the fall, the arena and impacts.
Power Paddle: unlock it with tears, activate with E or the POWER button; every third hit is a boosted strike.
Comeback rules: 4 down wakes your paddle until you lead by 2; 6 down gives the NPC the paddle for good. Perk: TheGreatsAreNeverForgotten.
Glass cracks branch from every impact, stay part of the pane, and shatter along the cracks.
Background eyes are dim and glow when their wall eye is hit; halfway through, they give way to one huge eye that pairs with a wall eye.
Whistling wind ambience, placeholder pong blips and a layered glass-break sound.
Reduce Motion setting.

updates.title: Physics feel pass
body: Thrust: Space or double-tap lunges your paddle and hands its speed to the ball.
Arena sways and tilts with impacts; wind blows the tears; the fall eases and surges.
Slice tears like fruit (mouse drag or touch swipe); tears are bigger and slower.
Plain walls no longer open eyes or drop tears; background eyes start closed and react.
Fog, falling parallax and speed streaks.
Procedural sound: falling air, eye squish, glass, thrust. M mutes.
Four NPC difficulties (Chill by default) and an easier start.
Settings button: difficulty, mode, volume.

updates.title: Online
body: Vercel deploy config, public updates feed for gsix.online.

updates.title: Foundation
body: Replayable runs (tick-stamped input), modes and modifiers as data, mount API, host interface, pause, local high score.

updates.title: First arena
body: Single arena vs AI with breakable glass, falling field, eyes, tears, zoom.
